title: Equity transfer dispute · Two parties · Three time points (illustrative data)

sources.name: Equity transfer agreement
sources.quote: The transferee shall pay the first instalment of RMB 3m within ten days after the agreement takes effect; the transferor shall cooperate in completing the change of registration after receiving payment.

sources.name: Bank payment receipt
sources.quote: On 15 March 2024 RMB 3m was paid, with a remark stating it was the first instalment of the equity transfer price.

sources.name: Business registration materials
sources.quote: As at the time of suit the transferee had not been registered as a shareholder; the change of registration was never made.

events.label: Transferor and transferee sign the equity transfer agreement
events.detail: It was agreed that the transferor would transfer 30% of the equity held by it to the transferee for RMB 9m, payable in three instalments.

events.label: Transferee pays the first instalment
events.detail: The transferee paid the first instalment of RMB 3m as agreed, and the transfer remark stated that it was the first instalment of the equity transfer price.

events.label: Transferor fails to cooperate with the registration change
events.summary: Two demands made, still not done
events.detail: After receiving payment the transferor did not cooperate, as agreed, in completing the change of business registration, and had still not done so after two demands from the transferee.

events.label: Transferee stops paying later instalments
events.summary: Refuses to pay, change not registered
events.detail: The transferee stopped paying the second instalment on the ground that the change of business registration had not been made.
